whatIsNelias.a: NELIAS is a Business Management Platform designed to bring business management capabilities together and configure them around an organization’s profile.

isErp.a: NELIAS includes ERP-type capabilities, but its positioning is broader: a platform approach built around business profiles, sector-aware configuration and connected workflows.

sectorEngine.a: The Sector Engine is the rules-based component designed to recommend a relevant configuration from your business profile and needs.

addLater.a: The platform helps to support evolving plans, capacities and optional capabilities, subject to catalogue availability.

multipleOffices.q: Do I pay more for multiple offices?
multipleOffices.a: Physical location alone is not a pricing factor. Additional operational capabilities, legal entities or services may affect the price.

hosting.q: Where will my data be hosted?
hosting.a: Hosting options depend on the subscription and technical requirements. NELIAS is being planned with African hosting options, including Côte d’Ivoire, subject to contractual confirmation.

connect.q: Can I connect NELIAS to other tools?
connect.a: Approved connectors and APIs are planned, with availability and fees varying by integration.

getStarted.q: How do I get started with NELIAS?
getStarted.a: Select “Configure My NELIAS” to describe your business, review a recommended configuration, and proceed through the currently available options.

tryNelias.a: demo access and trial offers depend on currently available services. Contact the team to register your interest.

moreThanOneCompany.q: Can I use NELIAS for more than one company?
moreThanOneCompany.a: Multi-entity capabilities depend on the plan and any additional legal-entity subscriptions.
